name: @deck.gl/aggregation-layers
description: deck.gl layers that aggregate the input data into alternative representations

readme.summary: The README provides a solid high-level overview of deck.gl with multiple installation flavors and learning resources, but is generic to the parent library rather than specific to the @deck.gl/aggregation-layers sub-package.
readme.top_issue: The README is for the entire deck.gl library, not the @deck.gl/aggregation-layers package specifically — it contains no information about what aggregation layers are, which layers are included, or how to use them.

common_complaints: Rendering bugs with layer occlusion (Mapbox Standard Style buildings)
Binary data rendering issues (ColumnLayer shapes incomplete)
Need for batch tile loading capabilities
Limited support for emerging tile formats (MLT, PMTiles, COG)
praise_themes: Active feature development and roadmap planning
Completion of major features (TypeScript support, WebGPU)
